description: Use this tool whenever a user asks when to claim Social Security between age 62 and age 70, what their Full Retirement Age (FRA) reduction or +8%/yr Delayed Retirement Credit (DRC) is, what cumulative lifetime break-even age applies, how spousal, survivor (20 CFR Sec. 404.335), or divorced-spouse benefits coordinate, or how the pre-FRA Earnings Test (42 U.S.C. Sec. 403(f)), IRC Sec. 86 taxability, and P.L. 118-273 WEP/GPO repeal apply.

deceasedPia.description: Deceased spouse monthly benefit/PIA in USD (if widowed).

exSpousePia.description: Ex-spouse monthly PIA in USD (if divorced after 10+ yr marriage).

lifeExpectancyAge.description: Planning longevity horizon age (used to rank cumulative lifetime benefits).

monthlyPiaAtFra.description: Estimated monthly Primary Insurance Amount (PIA) at Full Retirement Age in USD from SSA.gov.

otherRetirementIncome.description: Annual non-Social-Security income in USD (for IRC Sec. 86 provisional income taxability).

preFraEarnedWages.description: Annual W-2 / self-employment earned wages before FRA in USD (passive income is excluded from the SSA Earnings Test).

spousePia.description: Spouse monthly PIA at FRA in USD (if married).

name: analyze_social_security_claiming
title: Analyze Social Security Claiming Ages (62 to 70), Delayed Credits, Spousal/Survivor Coordination & Break-Even
